decisions.title: Gate recording gets explicit ask rules
decisions.rationale: The old allow list gated runner.py gate-answer only by omitting it; under sandbox auto-allow that omission gates nothing, so ask rules restore the prompt (design D10).

decisions.title: Guard-hook gaps are closed with ask rules, not hook changes
decisions.rationale: irreversible_guard.py is kept in step with the coordinator guardrails by tests outside this change (design D11).

decisions.title: The probe takes its read, write and connect functions as parameters
decisions.rationale: It can then be tested against a temporary tree in a container that has no sandbox, without touching the real home directory or the network.

decisions.title: alembic --help prompts
decisions.rationale: The existing 'alembic *' ask rule is kept as is; the guide uses that prompt to confirm ask rules apply to sandboxed commands.
